parameters.name: AccountName
parameters.description:
The name of the account.

>  You can specify only a standard account.

parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the PolarDB cluster.

parameters.name: DBName
parameters.description: The names of the databases. If you need to specify multiple database names, separate the names with commas (,).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb revoke-account-privilege --db-cluster-id pc-0000000000000000 --account-name testacc --db-name testdb --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardb RevokeAccountPrivilege --region cn-hangzhou --DBClusterId 'pc-0000000000000000' --DBName testdb --AccountName testacc
